_what: Source of truth for <eng>. train.py fits parameters to these label rules; golden.py and the RTL implement the widths and stream behaviour below. (From model/tiny_ai/spec.json.)

stream.input: one item per beat in s_data[7:0]; s_last marks the final beat of a frame
stream.output: two beats: beat 0 = {6'b0, error, class}, beat 1 = score, m_last on beat 1
stream.error: a beat whose s_data exceeds input_max (the beat is not used), or a frame whose length is not exactly inputs; beats past inputs are ignored
stream.latency: clock edges from the edge that accepts the last input beat to the edge that raises m_valid, counting both

<eng>.label: <the answer a human wants, in words>
<eng>.model: <structure with free numbers: e.g. one binary neuron: score = matches; class = score >= threshold>
